name: smaily-connect-blocks
description: Scripts collection for managing Smaily Connect block components

scripts.build: npm run build:checkout-optin && npm run build:newsletter-signup && npm run build:landingpage
scripts.ci: npm run ci:checkout-optin && npm run ci:newsletter-signup && npm run ci:landingpage
scripts.format: npm run format:checkout-optin && npm run format:newsletter-signup && npm run format:landingpage
scripts.lint:checkout-optin: npm --prefix ./checkout-optin/ run lint:js && npm --prefix ./checkout-optin/ run lint:css
scripts.lint:landingpage: npm --prefix ./landingpage/ run lint:js && npm --prefix ./landingpage/ run lint:css
scripts.lint:newsletter-signup: npm --prefix ./newsletter-signup/ run lint:js && npm --prefix ./newsletter-signup/ run lint:css
scripts.lint: npm run lint:checkout-optin && npm run lint:newsletter-signup && npm run lint:landingpage

author: Smaily
